trans-unit.target: Research projects ask the Board for extracts from the database here. Every participant sees the submitted requests; internal details stay with the applicant, the Board and the administrators.
Submitted data extract requests appear here.
Fill in every field except the optional dates and the publication. Saving keeps the request as a draft that only you see; you submit it on the next page.
After you submit, a Board member or an administrator checks the request formally and opens the vote. If the Board approves it, an administrator prepares the queries and releases the export for you.
Every participant sees these fields once the request is submitted.
What the Board approves. Participants see it without the recipients and the details of an enrichment.
Only you, the Board and the administrators see these fields.
A short name of the project.
A few sentences for participants: what the project wants to find out and why it needs the data.
The institution that carries the project.
The extract will be linked with data of your own. Then all votes of the Board must be in favour.
The question the extract is used for. The data may only be used for it.
First day of the allocations in the extract.
Last day of the allocations in the extract.
Which allocations belong to the extract, for example by indication, age or hospital group.
The fields the extract should contain.
How finely the data is grouped, for example by month and hospital group. Groups always contain at least three hospitals.
Who receives and works with the data. Not shown to participants.
Required when an enrichment is planned: which local data and how it is linked.
Only as a justified exception, when the question cannot be answered with aggregated values.
Background, method and expected result of the project.
Why the project needs these fields and this level of aggregation.
Who is responsible for the project and the data.
Name any conflicts of interest, or write "none".
Whether the project has an ethics vote or similar, or why it needs none.
Optional: where and when results are to be published.
These details are deliberately hidden. You only see whether they were given.

After submitting, the request can no longer be changed. Every participant sees it, and a Board member or an administrator checks it formally. You can only edit it again if it is returned or the Board asks for a revision.
Withdrawing ends the request for good. It cannot be reopened; for the same project you would have to submit a new request.
A submitted version can no longer be changed. If the formal check returns the request or the Board asks for a revision, you can edit it again and submit a new version.
You withdrew this request. Copies already downloaded cannot be recalled.
This request has only one version so far.
The versions do not differ in the fields you can see.
The SQL an administrator wrote for this request. Every participant can read it; each file becomes a CSV in the export.
Lowercase letters, digits and underscores; becomes the name of the CSV file.
One SELECT statement. Aggregated queries return the column _hospital_ids (array_agg(DISTINCT a.hospital_id)) in the same grouping, single-case queries _hospital_id; the export removes it.
The query cannot be released yet:
It must be a single SELECT (or WITH) statement.
Only one statement is allowed; remove the semicolons.
The table {table} is not on the allowlist.
The column {column} returns an internal ID; use it only to join or count.
The export connection is not set up (RESEARCH_DATABASE_URL), so queries cannot be checked or run.
More than {max} rows; the query needs to be narrowed.
{count} groups have fewer than {minimum} contributing hospitals; the export would be blocked.
Every group has at least {minimum} contributing hospitals.
The query is saved and checked.
The query could not be saved: check the file name, the description and the SQL.
The query does not pass the allowlist check, so it cannot run.
Submit the revised version by {date}; otherwise the request expires.
Waiting for the formal check by a Board member or an administrator.
{cast} of {eligible} votes cast, at least {quorum} needed
After a revision, the round is evaluated only at its deadline.
Required for a veto. The reason appears in the timeline as an internal comment; for "Needs revision" the applicant sees it as well.
carried over from the previous round
Private: the Board and the applicant
Public: everyone who can see the request
excluded {member} for a conflict of interest
Expired: the revision was not submitted in time
A comment needs between 1 and 5000 characters.
Message to the applicant (required for a revision)
Excluded for a conflict of interest
Declare your own conflict of interest
Reason for your conflict of interest
You then no longer vote on this request, do not count for the quorum and cannot do the formal check. This cannot be undone.
Exclude a Board member for a conflict of interest
Reason for the conflict of interest
The member then no longer votes on this request, does not count for the quorum and cannot do the formal check. This cannot be undone.
The exclusion for a conflict of interest is saved.
The request was returned to the applicant.
You may not take this step.
You are not eligible to vote in this round.
No Board member is eligible to vote on this request.
Edit the request first; your changes become the next version.
The draft is saved. Check it and submit it when it is complete.
This version can no longer be changed.
This step is not possible in the current state of the request.
The request was changed in the meantime. Please reload the page.

{accepted, select, 1 {accepted the conditions and started} other {started}} the export of release {release}
Export of release {release} provided, downloadable until {until}
Export of release {release} blocked: a group has too few hospitals
tried the export of release {release} again
The request cannot be released: every query needs a checked version, and single cases need the confirmation.
The request is released for the applicant.
The export is being created. This page shows when it is ready.
The export is being created again.
An administrator releases the approved queries for the applicant. The applicant then creates the export and downloads it within seven days.
The release binds the current version of the chosen queries and is valid for three months. Only these files are part of the export.
Leave out a query whose dry run shows groups below the minimum, after agreeing on it with the applicant in a comment. It stays with the request and can be released later.
dry run: {count, plural, one {# group} other {# groups}} below the minimum
I confirm that the single-case queries give timestamps at most to the hour and ages only in groups, as approved.
The export runs all released queries on the current data. You can start it once; afterwards you download the archive for seven days.
The export is being created. This can take a few minutes; reload the page later.
The archive can be downloaded until {date}.
The export could not be created. An administrator takes care of it.
The download period has ended. A new export needs a new release.
Nothing was provided: at least one group has fewer than {minimum} hospitals. Change the query in a new version and release again.
{count, plural, one {# group} other {# groups}} below the minimum, the first ones:
{rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} from {hospitals, plural, one {# hospital} other {# hospitals}}
Every row of an aggregated file is based on at least {minimum} hospitals.
The files are CSV in UTF-8 with a header row; manifest.json lists rows and SHA-256 checksums per file. The data is pseudonymised and may only be used for the approved purpose.
{source}, data extract for request no. {number}, data as of {data_as_of}, retrieved {retrieved}. {url}
The export connection is not set up (RESEARCH_DATABASE_URL): checks, dry runs and exports are disabled.
The export connection could change data. Set RESEARCH_DATABASE_URL to the read-only user of the hosting.
The export connection does not answer. Check RESEARCH_DATABASE_URL and the database user.
Release {release} expired: no export within three months
Export of release {release} cancelled with the withdrawal

The data may only be used for the approved purpose and within the approved project. Only the recipients named in the request have access to it, and passing it on to others is not allowed. The data is pseudonymised. Identifying single hospitals or persons, or linking the data with other sources for that purpose, is not permitted.
Only aggregated results are published, and every group they show is based on at least three hospitals. Publications name the source as the citation in the read-me suggests. Once the project is completed, the data is deleted.
Pre-filled with the usual rules; add what the Board decided, or empty the field for no conditions. The recipient accepts them before the export, and they appear in the read-me.
The export ended with the withdrawal of the request and can no longer be downloaded.
Please accept the conditions before you create the export.
Withdrawing ends the request for good. Open releases end, and exports that are running or ready can no longer be downloaded. Copies already downloaded cannot be recalled.
